sloka: सुतः किल स शक्रस्य वायसः पततां वरः ।धरान्तरचरः शीघ्रं पवनस्य गतौ समः ।। ५.६७.१० ।।।।
transliteration: sutaḥ kila sa śakrasya vāyasaḥ patatāṁ varaḥ ।dharāntaracaraḥ śīghraṁ pavanasya gatau samaḥ ।। 5.67.10 ।।।।

translations.english: 'That crow, the foremost of the birds was the son of Indra moving about all over the earth swiftly. His speed matched the Windgod's.
